name: write_stm_MC
title: Write MC compressed-column files after transposing the matrix.

.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(slam))

f <- tempfile()
m <- simple_triplet_matrix(i=c(1,2,1), j=c(1,1,2), v=c(1.5,2,3), nrow=2, ncol=2)

translation.example:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from slam import simple_triplet_matrix, write_stm_MC
folder = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
m = simple_triplet_matrix([1, 2, 1], [1, 1, 2], [1.5, 2, 3], 2, 2)
write_stm_MC(m, folder / "mc")
for suffix in ("_dim", "_row_ccs", "_col_ccs", "_tfn_nz"):
    print("\n".join((folder / ("mc" + suffix)).read_text().splitlines()))
